limitations: Specific to the friendship graph (windmill) token-swap Cayley graph; no general all-pairs shortest-path formula or arbitrary block-graph extension is proved. An unindexed preexisting equivalent result remains a research-priority risk.
scientific_integrity: Original theorem asserted only for integer t >= 2. Proof includes an all-order transposition-support lemma and exact extremal characterization; independent mathematical audit has not been performed. Computer checks confirm t = 1 through 4 but cannot prove the infinite theorem.
title: Sharp token-swapping diameter and antipodal classification on friendship graphs
